title: The attract page is a Panel P with a star tab and a full width table
why: The critic scored the attract board and how to play 2 of 5: the card barely separated from the page (near black, not the panel color), the table sat in a narrow block with the heading centred and the table left, no star tab. Now the page is the guide Panel P: --ui-panel at 90%, 24 and 32px padding, a 3px accent tab on the top edge, the headline at the left edge, the table full width with the action column at 24%. No wording moved.
now: The attract page is a proper panel with a tab, and the table fills it.

edits.anchor: body #attract .arcpage{ padding:calc(var(--sp-3) * var(--attz,1)) calc(var(--sp-4) * var(--attz,1)); background:var(--ui-scrim); border:1px solid var(--ui-line-hi); border-radius:var(--rad); font:600 calc(var(--fs-body) * var(--attz,1))/1.4 var(--f-cond); letter-spacing:var(--track); color:var(--tx-1); text-shadow:none; }
body #attract .arcpage .aph{ font-size:calc(var(--fs-title) * var(--attz,1)); line-height:1.1; font-weight:700; color:var(--tx-1); margin-bottom:calc(var(--sp-2) * var(--attz,1)); }
edits.replacement: body #attract .arcpage .aph{ font-size:calc(var(--fs-title) * var(--attz,1)); line-height:1.1; font-weight:700; color:var(--tx-1); text-align:left; margin-bottom:calc(var(--sp-3) * var(--attz,1)); }

body #attract .arcpage .apk{ color:var(--tx-2); width:24%; }
body #attract .arcpage td, body #attract .arcpage th{ text-align:left; padding-left:0; }
